points.title: Generative AI Solutions with Azure OpenAI: Provisioning and deploying models in Microsoft Foundry

points.title: Generative AI Solutions with Azure OpenAI: Prompt engineering and templates

points.title: Zero-Trust Security Architecture: Zero-Trust strategy, MCRA, and MCSB
